findings.title: Scrollable slide bodies are not keyboard-focusable

evidence.axe: scrollable-region-focusable · serious · 1 node per slide (`.s-body.br-body`) on 47 desktop EN/AR, 46/47/48 phone EN/AR; `#s-brand-foundations` on phone

findings.rootCause: dist/js/brand-section.js body(): the dense reference body gets overflow-y:auto (brand-section.css .br-slide .s-body.br-body) but no tabindex/role
findings.fixSpec: Make `.s-body.br-body` a named region: tabindex=0, role=region, aria-label="<slide title> — Slide content — scrolls"; add a visible 3 px focus ring (`.br-body:focus-visible`); tighten the desktop rhythm so 46/48 do not scroll at 1440x900 (see A-13)

findings.wcag: 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value; ARIA dialog pattern
findings.title: Lightbox dialog has no accessible name tied to its content (no aria-labelledby; inherits "Enlarge")

evidence.measured: opened dialog: role=dialog ✓ aria-modal=true ✓ aria-labelledby=null ✗ aria-label="Enlarge"/"تكبير" (the tile's button label) — a screen reader announces "Enlarge, dialog"

findings.rootCause: brand-section.js expandFig(): sets role/aria-modal only; the figure keeps aria-label="Enlarge" from galleryTile()
findings.fixSpec: Give the caption text span an id; tile aria-labelledby=<caption-txt id> (+ aria-describedby=<source id>); when expanded keep role=dialog aria-modal=true aria-labelledby; no aria-label on the dialog; restore on close

findings.wcag: 4.1.2; ARIA in HTML (figure allows no button/dialog role); axe aria-allowed-role (minor x11); Lighthouse label-content-name-mismatch

findings.title: #/29/brand-1…3 aliases normalise away from the address bar (shown as #/28/brand-k) at boot and at runtime

measured.router: compiled bundle Pd() = /^#\/(\d{1,2})/ → index for 1..28, else 0 (cover): a bare #/29 reaching the router sends the deck to the cover

evidence.risk: LOW when done as replaceState AFTER the hashchange dispatch (no event → the router never sees #/29); reloads use the pre-boot alias in index.html; #/28/brand-k and #slide-46…48 unaffected

findings.fixSpec: Register the public alias: show(k) keeps #/28/brand-k during the dispatch, then setTimeout(0) → replaceState #/29/brand-k; hashchange accepts both forms; rail link href #/29/brand-1; tryDeep tolerates the alias; qa hashFor(46–48) = #/29/brand-k
